The '''1716 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 12th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[Easuhura]] across [[Ayuma]], and was won by [[Raledria]], who defeated [[Emara]] 2-1 in the final.

The 1716 tournament was the subject of the first significant administrative controversy in the competition's history. The hosting rights had originally been awarded to [[Estijan]] in 1712 but were withdrawn by the FLLA Council in November 1714 following the disclosure of a coordinated programme of performance-enhancing pharmaceutical use within the Estijan domestic league. The tournament passed to [[Easuhura]], which staged the competition at four months' notice. [[Raledria]] retained the trophy with a 2-1 final-day victory over [[Emara]]; the run from 1700 to 1716 made Raledria the only side to have lifted the trophy at three editions in succession.
